feed.title: Junichi Koganemaru
feed.subtitle: I am a mathematician with a Ph.D. in Mathematics from Carnegie Mellon University. I was a postdoctoral associate at Carnegie Mellon University from 2023 to 2025. My research interests include nonlinear partial differential equations, fluid dynamics, and functional analysis. I specialize in the analysis of the incompressible Navier-Stokes equations with free boundary, which describe the motion of viscous fluid substances.
